<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/internal/management/teams/cards"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



FindTeamsByCardNumber retrieves teams information by searching for a card using its number,
then finding the associated driver and finally the teams.
Returns 200 with empty data array if no teams are found for the card number.
